## Change

What behavior or contract changed, and why?

## Verification

## Compatibility and third-party rights

Describe protocol/API compatibility effects, error/reconnect behavior, added dependencies and any incorporated third-party source or assets. For game-facing changes, state the multiplayer refusal and cleanup checks performed.
